problem_text:
A logistics company needs to allocate its delivery fleet among 16 regional distribution centers to maximize total delivery efficiency.  
The performance characteristics for each center are as follows:  
* Center A: efficiency score 0.115, resource usage 0.095, allocation limits [0.045, 0.840]  
* Center B: efficiency score 0.145, resource usage 0.018, allocation limits [0.034, 0.503]  
* Center C: efficiency score 0.102, resource usage 0.051, allocation limits [0.038, 0.327]  
* Center D: efficiency score 0.026, resource usage 0.237, allocation limits [0.083, 0.702]  
* Center E: efficiency score 0.048, resource usage 0.132, allocation limits [0.083, 0.566]  
* Center F: efficiency score 0.121, resource usage 0.282, allocation limits [0.013, 0.466]  
* Center G: efficiency score 0.186, resource usage 0.098, allocation limits [0.014, 0.353]  
* Center H: efficiency score 0.041, resource usage 0.092, allocation limits [0.064, 0.399]  
* Center I: efficiency score 0.173, resource usage 0.063, allocation limits [0.076, 0.315]  
* Center J: efficiency score 0.040, resource usage 0.225, allocation limits [0.067, 0.678]  
* Center K: efficiency score 0.087, resource usage 0.011, allocation limits [0.015, 0.763]  
* Center L: efficiency score 0.072, resource usage 0.169, allocation limits [0.073, 0.485]  
* Center M: efficiency score 0.114, resource usage 0.030, allocation limits [0.009, 0.687]  
* Center N: efficiency score 0.041, resource usage 0.023, allocation limits [0.062, 0.686]  
* Center O: efficiency score 0.075, resource usage 0.150, allocation limits [0.062, 0.351]  
* Center P: efficiency score 0.087, resource usage 0.100, allocation limits [0.039, 0.873]  

Each center must receive a proportion of the total fleet allocation within its specified limits, and the sum of all allocation proportions must equal one. To maintain operational readiness, the company requires that the group of high-priority centers, represented by the set L = {A, C, F, G, H, J, K, M, O}, collectively receive at least 0.366 of the total fleet allocation. Additionally, the total resource usage across all centers must not exceed 0.139, and the overall delivery efficiency must be no less than 0.072. Determine the optimal allocation of fleet resources that maximizes total delivery efficiency while satisfying all constraints.
